public final class Example {

        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"xml\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("<?xml version=\"1.0\"?>\n<root>hello</root>", config);
